decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product with dedicated website presentation in a growing and R&D-active firm, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and the firm has enough slack to continue backing it.

Although only briefly presented, it is still close to the established software offer, so absent clear underperformance a medium-sized expanding firm would usually retain it while results remain uncertain.

Its own page suggests meaningful commitment, and as an adjacent infrastructure product in a firm with broad capabilities and hiring-related slack it is more likely to be carried forward than quickly withdrawn.

This is a more niche hardware item with weaker website prominence, so its aspiration attainment is less certain, but the favorable industry context and fit with the firm's installed-base business still support keeping it for now.

Control technology is central to the firm's integrated water-engineering offer, and in a growing market a boundedly rational management would usually keep such a product unless stronger evidence of shortfall appears.
